name: gleaming-smolder-draws-then-discards
notes: Gleaming Smolder: the effect 'Draw a card and discard a card' used to never run (the card only paid its cost). It now draws one card and prompts for the discard.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Gleaming Smolder's effect was generated as an $enterAbilities entry, but it is an Action that never enters the field, so activating it only paid its cost and sent it to the graveyard: the effect never ran. Fix: OnCardActivated() runs an Action's enter ability as its resolution effect when the card has no activation ability of its own.
